Message:
That was my brother,
now back on his feet,
wishing me a happy birthday.

With his face
beaming with energy,
he seemed fully recovered.
This is all thanks to God...

I was worried after hearing
my memories would be
the price I’d have to pay.
But, it looks like not everything
was taken away from me.

Well, I guess my
childhood memories do feel
a bit blurrier than before.

Still, those with my brother
remain safe and sound.

“Here are my presents
to you, Big Sis.
A scarf and a stuffed doll!”

“Wow, you made
all these by yourself?
It must’ve been hard to do.”

“They’re for you, Big Sis!
Doing something like this
is super easy!”

Ahh, thank goodness.
He really has gotten better.

Our once dark days are now
bright with happiness.

I know we’ll only have
more of them...
Bright days...
that shine like treasures...
